baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperfect middle-form verb يَتَجَنَّبُهَا makes ٱلْأَشْقَى the agent of an ongoing self-positioning away from a feminine referent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The side-root becomes a relation deliberately broken: the agent moves himself out of adjacency with the referent. Read with the wretchedness branch of the split ش ق و inventory, the superlative is not only a prior label but a condition enacted and exposed by this withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Keeping aside, avoidance, and estrangement supply the verb's literal motion and make self-exile the model's operative relation.
Wretchedness opposite happiness supplies the agent's superlative condition and lets the distancing action diagnose that condition.

changed_reading.before: A maximally wretched person simply avoids an unspecified feminine object.
changed_reading.after: The maximally wretched person makes wretchedness visible by continually relocating himself to the far side of the feminine referent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْأَشْقَى can activate both mapped ش ق و inventories, where hardship and labor coexist with wretchedness, while يَتَجَنَّبُهَا supplies maintained distance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Avoidance is not effortless nonattendance. The split root makes it an exertion: the agent keeps working to preserve separation, so the attempted escape becomes part of the hardship named by the superlative.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal and active removal to a side supply the distance that must be maintained.
Strenuous suffering and endurance supply the energetic cost of keeping the referent away.
Hardship, difficulty, and toil preserve the labor reading in the second mapped inventory rather than reducing ش ق و to a moral label.

changed_reading.before: The predicate reports a bad recipient's easy refusal.
changed_reading.after: The one deepest in hardship labors to hold the referent at a distance; evasion is itself a toil-producing practice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ج ن ب inventory places adjacency at one's side beside the derived verb's avoidance, and the imperfect يَتَجَنَّبُ presents the boundary as active rather than settled.
baseline_models.mechanism: The referent is not simply absent. Avoidance reverses a live side-by-side relation, implying something close enough to require recurrent lateral repositioning. The verse can therefore stage contested proximity: the agent remains defined by what he tries to put aside.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and companionship at one's side supply the latent proximity against which avoidance operates.
Removal and estrangement reverse that adjacency and turn a stable side into an actively defended boundary.
Wretchedness names the person whose identity remains relationally bound to the object he excludes.

changed_reading.before: He leaves the referent behind in a clean, completed departure.
changed_reading.after: He sustains a side-boundary against something still close enough to press upon him; avoidance discloses contested nearness, not freedom from relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context builds a directed world: shaping establishes orientation, measured governance sets a course, guidance gently indicates it, and easing opens movement along it. Against that sequence, the focus verb is not arbitrary avoidance but self-directed lateral motion across or away from an afforded route.

activation_trace.role: Removal to the side supplies the focus action that becomes counter-motion within the contextual course.
Turning and intending a direction supply an oriented trajectory rather than undifferentiated movement.
Ordering by measure and deliberation supplies the course's fitted arrangement.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies positive direction and makes the focus side-step a counter-guidance.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply an afforded passage that the focus agent nevertheless leaves.
Light, compliant movement sharpens the contrast between being eased along and forcing oneself sideways.

structural_cues: 87:2-3 chains shaping, apportioning, and guidance with consecutive فَ, and 87:8 resumes first-person causative easing toward ٱلْيُسْرَى.
The focus imperfect middle-form assigns the contrary displacement to the agent himself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several directional and facilitative branch images; I infer that they share a path-space and that the focus motion crosses it. A live alternative is a purely ethical contrast in which the spatial coherence is only figurative.

changed_reading.before: The agent withdraws from an isolated object.
changed_reading.after: The agent takes himself off a measured, indicated, and eased course; wretchedness appears as counter-guidance performed from within an already afforded path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation gathers and presents material, non-forgetting blocks accidental loss, and the repeated remembrance sequence culminates in a fear-responsive recipient who recollects. The focus feminine pronoun then most immediately takes the reminder as its object, so avoidance becomes an active anti-memory relation rather than mere ignorance or lapse.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate withdrawal supplies the action that contrasts with recollection and excludes a merely cognitive lapse.
Gathering and bringing together supply a presented, coherent object from which the focus agent separates himself.
Loss of remembrance supplies the cognitive failure explicitly blocked before the focus, forcing a more volitional account of avoidance.
A reminder as that which makes one remember supplies the likely feminine antecedent and the object that remains available for uptake.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the reminder's offered efficacy, which avoidance declines rather than fails to encounter.
Fear joined with awe supplies the receptive disposition whose remembrance is contrasted with the focus agent's distancing.

structural_cues: 87:9 names ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ and 87:11 follows with the feminine object pronoun هَا after 87:10 repeats the remembrance root.
The sequence moves from guaranteed recitation and non-forgetting to reminder, recollection, and then avoidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the feminine reminder, repeated remembrance, and active withdrawal; I infer ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ as the nearest antecedent and contrast withdrawal with available recollection. The pronoun can still carry the broader recited message or eased course, so the object need not be narrowed to one noun.

changed_reading.before: The most wretched fails to receive or remember a message.
changed_reading.after: A gathered and beneficial reminder reaches the field of memory, but the most wretched actively removes himself from it; the failure is resistant relation, not missing information.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus agent can move to the side of the reminder, but the preceding knowledge frame spans both manifest and hidden domains. Spatial or social evasion therefore fails as concealment: the motion away is itself disclosed even if its motive remains inward.

activation_trace.role: Distance, withdrawal, and foreignness supply the attempted evasion whose epistemic success is reversed.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the frame in which the avoider's displacement remains legible.
Manifest appearance to the eye supplies the public pole across which the act can be seen.
Concealment and hiddenness supply the inward pole that does not escape the stated knowledge.

structural_cues: 87:7 balances ٱلْجَهْرَ against وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ under one knowing subject.
87:11 gives the avoider an overt verb but no quoted reason, leaving outward motion and hidden motive available together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive knowledge and an act of withdrawal; I infer an attempted concealment and its failure. The live alternative is that 87:7 concerns preservation of recitation rather than the avoider's psychology, leaving only an epistemic frame rather than a motive.

changed_reading.before: Moving aside successfully creates distance from the reminder.
changed_reading.after: The avoider may leave the reminder's side, but cannot move the act or its concealed motive outside knowledge; avoidance becomes exposed evasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A remote focus branch imagines a shield held at the side, while the immediately following fire-root inventory joins direct fire contact to the back or flank. The attempted lateral defense is reversed: putting the reminder off to one's side does not shield the agent but leads into exposure of the very bodily side being guarded.

activation_trace.role: A shield or cover held at the side supplies avoidance as a defensive posture rather than neutral distance.
Flank pain or injury supplies the bodily vulnerability that the imagined side-shield attempts to protect.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the consequence that defeats the defensive reading of avoidance.
The back-and-flank body part supplies a precise bodily hinge between the focus side image and the following fire contact.
Blazing fire and branding supply invasive contact rather than a threat kept safely outside the boundary.

structural_cues: 87:12 immediately continues ٱلْأَشْقَى with the relative clause ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى, preserving the same agent across the boundary.
The focus and following verse both admit branch images localized at the side or flank.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies side-shield, flank vulnerability, direct fire contact, and a continuing relative clause; I infer a failed-protection reversal. The alternative is noncausal lexical resonance, so the model remains exploratory rather than a translation of either verb.

changed_reading.before: Avoidance protects the agent by keeping a threatening reminder away.
changed_reading.after: The self-protective side maneuver fails: the next state reaches the very flank imagined as guarded, turning avoidance into exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hardship branch of ٱلْأَشْقَى is temporally expanded by the paired negations that follow. Neither loss of life nor beneficial life completes the process, so the avoider's toil becomes unresolved persistence rather than a severe but terminating episode.

activation_trace.role: Strenuous hardship and endurance supply the focus condition that the next verse stretches through time.
Departure of force and life supplies one unavailable endpoint of the hardship.
Stillness and extinguishing supply a second image of cessation that the negation withholds.
Life as benefit and good supplies the opposite endpoint also denied, distinguishing bare continuation from flourishing.

structural_cues: 87:13 coordinates لَا يَمُوتُ and وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ around the same locative state.
ثُمَّ extends the consequence after the fire-contact clause rather than opening a new agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hardship plus the denial of both cessation and beneficial life; I infer temporal suspension as the mechanism linking them. The alternative is that the negations describe only a later punishment and do not feed back into the lexical force of ٱلْأَشْقَى.

changed_reading.before: ٱلْأَشْقَى names someone intensely unhappy at the moment of avoidance.
changed_reading.after: The superlative names a toil that cannot resolve into either extinction or flourishing; avoidance opens an enduring suspended condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The successful counterpart is built through actions: self-purification grows and cleans, remembrance restores presence, and prayer establishes worship. This revises the focus superlative from a fixed type into the outcome of an opposite self-practice: one agent works on himself toward fitness, while the other works himself sideways from the reminder.

activation_trace.role: Self-removal and estrangement supply the negative practice that can be compared with self-purification.
Wretchedness supplies the resulting agent-description, now read dynamically rather than as unexplained essence.
Success and lasting attainment supply the positive outcome opposed to wretchedness.
Growth and increase supply self-directed cultivation rather than self-directed displacement.
Purity and soundness supply the fitting condition produced by the positive practice.
Bringing something present after forgetting supplies receptive recollection as the opposite of active avoidance.
Specified worship supplies the embodied culmination of the alternative sequence.

structural_cues: 87:14-15 gives the successful مَن a sequence of finite actions, while 87:11 predicates an imperfect action of ٱلْأَشْقَى.
تَزَكَّىٰ and يَتَجَنَّبُ both present agent-involving derived forms, enabling a contrast between two directions of self-work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed agentive sequences and branch images of cultivation, recollection, worship, and withdrawal; I infer that character labels crystallize from practiced orientation. The alternative is that the morphological parallel is only formal and that the labels remain prior states.

changed_reading.before: The verse sorts an already fixed wretched class from others.
changed_reading.after: The verse catches a self-forming practice in motion: the wretched agent repeatedly trains himself away from reminder, opposite the cultivation-remembrance-prayer sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast redescribes avoidance as an allocation of proximity. Preference draws the near life to one's side, while the delayed, beneficial, enduring term is placed away. The focus agent does not merely flee; he arranges companions and horizons, attaching himself to what is near and lateralizing what lasts.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and companionship at one's side supply the positive placement granted to the preferred term.
Removal and estrangement supply the complementary placement imposed on the reminder and its horizon.
Choosing one thing in preference supplies the selection rule that turns avoidance into relational allocation.
Taking something exclusively for oneself sharpens the self-enclosing side of the preference.
Closeness and approach supply the immediate term pulled into companionship.
Deferral to a later time supplies the horizon that can be kept psychologically offside.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the value that the enacted preference misorders.
Duration and remaining supply the long horizon excluded by attachment to the near.

structural_cues: بَلْ in 87:16 reopens the diagnosis in the second person plural and is followed by a balanced near-life/later-life comparison.
The focus side-root supplies a spatial grammar for the later verbs and comparatives of choice, nearness, delay, benefit, and duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, nearness, delay, benefit, duration, and side relations; I infer that avoidance distributes these terms between intimate and excluded positions. The alternative is that 87:16 broadens to a different audience and explains the focus agent only by analogy.

changed_reading.before: Avoidance is a single negative response to a reminder.
changed_reading.after: Avoidance is a preference topology: the near life is kept as side-companion while the beneficial and lasting horizon is pushed away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing attestation gives the avoided reminder a durable and recurrent medium. Written sheets preserve it from the agent's withdrawal, while beginning, return-to-outcome, and succession make the message precede this encounter and continue beyond it. Avoidance changes position, not the reminder's availability or historical persistence.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal and foreignness supply the local attempt to sever relation with the reminder.
A written sheet supplies durable inscription that remains when a hearer moves away.
Beginning and precedence supply a history earlier than the focus agent's act.
Return to outcome or final consequence turns firstness into a temporal arc that can outlast immediate evasion.
One thing following another supplies transmission and recurrence from a non-dominant mapped branch.

structural_cues: 87:18 points deictically to هَٰذَا and locates it in earlier sheets; 87:19 repeats صُحُفِ and names two prior bearers.
The closing backward reach counters the focus agent's attempt to make the reminder foreign or peripheral.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written preservation, precedence, outcome, and succession; I infer durability and recurrence as what defeats withdrawal. The alternative is that the closing verses provide only authority and attestation, not a temporal mechanism within 87:11.

changed_reading.before: The agent can end his relation to a passing oral reminder by stepping aside.
changed_reading.after: He can only change his own position relative to an inscribed, recurrent reminder that precedes him and continues toward an outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote low-shrub branch of the focus side-root through the pasture-to-dark-scum sequence. It remains valid as a material echo anchored in ج ن ب and the focus act of taking a side-position, but downstream prose should call it an ecological sorting resonance, not translate يَتَجَنَّبُ as vegetation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ج ن ب inventory behind يَتَجَنَّبُ includes independent low perennial side-growth, which the immediately preceding pasture and plant-decay sequence can awaken.

activation_trace.role: Low perennial shrub growth supplies a marginal, persisting plant-position within the focus root.
Pasture and grazing growth supply the productive field from which material can later be sorted.
Scum floating and carried by floodwater supplies expelled, mobile residue rather than rooted persistence.
Pasture become dry debris supplies the transformation that makes ecological side-taking consequential.
Blackness or dark redness supplies the terminal material condition of the transformed growth.

changed_reading.before: The focus is exclusively a psychological scene of human refusal.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological echo, the avoider takes a marginal side-position within a world where nourishing growth is sorted into rooted remainder or dark carried-off debris.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the non-dominant و س م mapping under ٱسْم and a mark branch under knowledge to reinterpret ٱلْأَشْقَى diagnostically. It remains anchored in the focus agent's visible act and label, but it should be rendered as a cross-root marking echo, never as the lexical meaning of ٱسْم or ٱلْأَشْقَى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus couples a public imperfect action with a superlative agent-label, allowing the act of taking oneself aside to function as the sign by which the condition becomes recognizable.

activation_trace.role: Active withdrawal supplies the observable behavior that can leave or constitute a diagnostic mark.
Wretchedness supplies the condition identified by that behavior rather than an arbitrary external label.
A visible impressed mark by which a thing is known supplies the non-dominant marking mechanism.
A distinguishing trace that guides recognition supplies the epistemic function of the avoider's act.

changed_reading.before: ٱلْأَشْقَى is a label applied before and independently of the action.
changed_reading.after: The act of withdrawing from the reminder becomes the visible trace by which extreme wretchedness identifies itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately contained sporting image: the focus side-root can denote a spare animal led alongside, the hardship root can denote contest, and the prayer root can denote the runner following the leader. The shared course makes it anchored and mechanistically coherent, but downstream prose must call it a race-position echo rather than lexicalize the verse as a race.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَجَنَّبُ can activate being led or kept alongside, so the focus agent may be pictured as self-sidelining instead of entering the following position opened by the surrounding course language.

activation_trace.role: A spare animal or captive led alongside supplies the focus agent's displaced, parallel position.
Being outdone in a hardship contest supplies competitive loss within the side-position.
Light, compliant movement supplies the available course that could have been followed.
The runner immediately following the leader supplies the ordered position opposed to remaining a spare at the side.

changed_reading.before: The avoider simply exits the field.
changed_reading.after: In a qualified race-course echo, he does not disappear but assigns himself the losing side-position, parallel to a course whose successful figure follows rather than sidesteps.

strongest_changes: The recitation-remembrance sequence resolves the feminine object toward the reminder and changes avoidance from cognitive failure into deliberate anti-memory.
Measured guidance and easing turn the side-root into counter-trajectory: the agent removes himself from an already afforded course.
The near-life/later-life contrast turns avoidance into a topology of preference, companionship, and exclusion.
Fire contact and the denial of both death and beneficial life expand the hardship branch of ٱلْأَشْقَى into suspended, nonterminating toil.
Purification, remembrance, and prayer reveal a contrary self-practice, so wretchedness can be read as enacted orientation rather than fixed essence.
summary.what_was_special: The split ش ق و mapping kept wretchedness and strenuous toil alive together, while ج ن ب supplied a productive reversal between adjacency and avoidance. Context then activated path, memory, visibility, bodily flank, temporal suspension, preference, inscription, and several carefully contained material echoes without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The nearest antecedent of هَا is ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ, but the pronoun may carry the broader recited message or the eased course as a whole.

The path, shield, marking, ecological, and race mechanisms depend on reader-supplied directional links between packet branches; their branch support is explicit, but their causal arrows are abductive.
Non-dominant mapped roots produce real activations, especially the marking and succession readings, yet their lower mapping rank warrants qualified rendering.
It remains open whether the side/flank overlap with 87:12 is an intended bodily reversal or only a strong lexical resonance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Avoidance as lateral self-removal.** Lexical evidence: ج ن ب B003 (keeping aside/avoidance), ش ق و B002 (hardship and strenuous suffering). Structural cue: 87:10 receptive remembrance is immediately contrasted with the one who avoids it. Assigned role: يتجنب names the body's movement to the side; الأشقى names the hardship-state that results. Abductive move: moving aside from reminder is not neutral distance but the beginning of hardship. Reading change: avoidance itself is the path into wretchedness.

2. **Side-position against guided path.** Lexical evidence: ج ن ب B001/B002 (side/flank, nearness at side), ه د ي B002/B003 in 87:3 (course and leading front), ي س ر B001 in 87:8. Structural cue: guided/easy path contrasts with stepping aside. Assigned role: جنب supplies spatial deviation from the front-led course. Abductive move: moral refusal is a lateral displacement from the route. Reading change: the ayah reads as path geometry: the wretched one does not just ignore reminder; he sidesteps the way.

3. **Mountain hardship contest.** Lexical evidence: ش ق و B003/B004 (hardship contest; long rising mountain flank easier to climb/sit on), ع ل و B001/B004 in 87:1 (height/mastery), ك ب ر B010 in 87:12 (great hardship/heaviness). Structural cue: highest Lord and greatest fire frame the superlative الأشقى. Assigned role: shiqwa becomes a hard ascent/rivalry with the divine upward scale. Abductive move: refusal tries to take another rising path, but that path becomes hardship. Reading change: "wretched" carries the image of exhausting ascent, not only misery.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:12's الكبرى made الأشقى feel superlative within a scale of burdensome greatness. 87:8's اليسرى also retroactively made يتجنبها a lateral move away from an eased road.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Avoidance as moving to the side of reminder.** Lexical evidence: جنب B003 keeping aside/avoiding/distance; شقو B002 hardship/strenuous suffering. Structural cue: the pronoun "ها" points back to الذكرى, and the verse stands opposite 87:10. Assigned role: جنب describes spatial-moral withdrawal; شقو names the one defined by hardship. Abductive move: the packet supplies avoidance and hardship; I infer that avoiding reminder causes or reveals wretchedness. Reading change: the ayah is not passive unbelief but active sidestepping of a beneficial summons.

2. **Side-nearness as failed proximity.** Lexical evidence: جنب B001 side/flank and B002 nearness/companionship at one's side; رعي B004 attentive hearing; ذكر B004 mention. Structural cue: the reminder is near enough to be avoided. Assigned role: جنب can imply being at the side but refusing direct reception. Abductive move: the packet supplies side-nearness and avoidance; I infer that the wretched one is not ignorant by distance but evasive at close range. Reading change: the ayah becomes more culpable: he turns aside from what is beside him.

3. **Hardship contest and false ascent.** Lexical evidence: شقو B003 prevailing in a hardship contest; شقو B004 long rising mountain flank; علو B003 haughty domination and سمو B007 rivaling. Structural cue: the surah began with الأعلى and later contrasts الكبرى fire. Assigned role: شقو's mountain/hardship branches supply a parody of ascent: climbing into hardship rather than rising by praise. Abductive move: the packet supplies ascent-like hardship and true elevation; I infer a counter-ascent. Reading change: "الأشقى" becomes the one who takes the hard rising flank away from the Highest.

4. **Loss of custodial care.** Lexical evidence: جنب B008 scarcity of camel milk; رعي B002 shepherding/care and ربب B002 nurture. Structural cue: the avoidant appears after pasture/care imagery. Assigned role: avoidance removes one from the care economy. Abductive move: the packet supplies side-withdrawal and milk-scarcity; I infer deprivation as the social/ecological consequence of evasion. Reading change: wretchedness is being outside nourishment and guidance, not only punishment later.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:12-13 confirmed that avoidance leads into a suspended, sterile state. 87:16 clarified the motive: preference for the nearer life is the practical form of sidestepping the reminder.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Avoidance is active spatial self-placement.** `ج ن ب/B003` gives keeping aside, distancing, and withdrawal; `ش ق و/B002` gives hardship and strenuous suffering. The pronoun ties the movement to the reminder, and 87:12–13 immediately extends that sideways move into fire and a state with neither death nor life. Avoidance supplies the initial displacement; hardship supplies the resulting course. I infer the directional arrow from side-stepping to outcome. The ayah reads as self-routing away from an available address, not passive failure to hear.
2. **The same side-image exposes failed proximity.** `ج ن ب/B002` gives nearness or companionship at one’s side, whereas the surface form selects `ج ن ب/B003`, withdrawal. The reminder has just been made present in 87:9–10, so the root holds adjacency and separation in direct tension. Its role is to show that distance is produced in the presence of something near. I infer availability from the preceding imperative and response. The reading changes from absence of guidance to a deliberate rupture of proximity.
3. **Avoidance behaves like an attempted shield that reverses into exposure.** `ج ن ب/B011` is a shield or cover held at the side. The root’s protective image is activated by the immediate movement into `ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ`: moving the reminder aside can be modeled as attempted self-protection, but the sequel reveals that maneuver as ineffective. The packet supplies avoidance and fire; I supply the protective intention and its reversal. The ayah thus permits an ironic reading in which the chosen “shield” is precisely what leaves the person exposed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:12 immediately overturned the protective possibility of `ج ن ب/B011`: the attempted side-shield becomes exposure to fire. 87:13 then made `ش ق و/B002` causal rather than classificatory, because the spatial act of avoidance opens into hardship that has neither terminal closure nor beneficial life.

findings.text: Kaçınma, erişilebilir ve yakındaki bir çağrıyla bağı bilinçli biçimde koparan etkin bir yana çekilmedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın veya hayvanın böğrünü, bir şeyin yanını ve bu temel anlamdan gelişen bitişik çevreyi birlikte doğrular. Vadi ve ordu gibi yapıların iki yanı ile böğürden alınan deri parçası, aynı yan bölge çekirdeğinin belirli uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca uzak durmayı değil, somut bir yanı, yan bölgeyi veya ona bitişik çevreyi bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım, özel bir söz öbeğine bağlı anlamları çekirdeğe katmadan yan ve bitişik çevre alanını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: İnsan ya da hayvan gövdesinin böğrü veya herhangi bir şeyin yanı ve bu yana bitişik yakın çevredir. İki yandan oluşan düzenlerde her bir yanı, ayrıca böğürden alınan deri parçasını da adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin böğrünü ve bir şeyin yanını ya da tarafını belirtir.
Bir evin veya topluluğun yerleşimine bitişik yakın çevreyi belirtebilir.
Vadi, ordu veya ırmak gibi bir bütünün iki yanından her birini belirtir.
Devenin böğründen alınan ve kap yapımında kullanılabilen deri parçasını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Anlamın ortak çekirdeği bedenin veya bir nesnenin yanıdır. Yakın çevre, iki yandan biri ve böğür derisinden alınan parça bu mekansal çekirdeğin belirli uzantılarıdır.

Etken ve edilgen katılımcı yönleri tanımda ayrı tutulmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yakın komşuluğu değil, kişinin uzak durmasını, başkasını uzaklaştırmasını veya uzaklık sonucu yabancı kalmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın uzaklık alanı ile belirli yapılardaki kaçınma, koruma ve yabancılık kullanımları ayrıştırılır; yapı anlamları bütüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya şeyle araya mesafe koymak, ondan uzak durmak ya da birini ondan uzaklaştırmaktır. Bu ayrılma kötülükten korunma, insanlardan ayrı yaşama veya soy ve yer bakımından yabancı olma sonucunu da doğurabilir.

facets.statement: Kişinin bir şeyden uzaklaşmasını, ona yaklaşmamasını veya onu bırakmasını belirtir.
Bir kimseyi bir şeyden uzaklaştırmayı veya kötülüğü ondan savmayı belirtir.
İnsanlardan ayrı bir yerde durma ve yalnız kalma durumuna uzanır.
Akrabalık, soy veya yerleşim bakımından uzak olan yabancı kişiyi belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam mesafe koyma ve yakınlığı kesmedir. Kişinin kendisinin uzak durması, başka birini uzaklaştırması, kötülüğü savması, ayrı kalması ve yabancı sayılması bu çekirdeğin katılımcı ve sonuç çeşitleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem kişinin kendisinin mesafe koymasını hem de bir başkasını bir şeyden uzak tutmayı kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklaşan ve uzaklaştıran katılımcı yönlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin topluluktan çekilip ayrı bir yerde kalması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluktan ayrılma ve ayrı yerde kalma anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Soy veya yerleşim yakınlığı bulunmayan bir kişinin nitelenmesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Soy veya yer bakımından uzak ve yabancı olma sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi cinsel ilişki sonrasında oluşan dinsel durumu, bu durumdaki kişi ve toplulukları ve adlandırmanın arınmaya kadar belirli ibadetlerden ve yerlerden uzak durma gerekçesini açıkça destekler. Bu uzak durma genel kaçınma değil, belirli bir dinsel hükmün sonucudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel uzaklık veya bedensel yan anlamını değil, cinsel ilişki sonrası arınmaya dek süren dinsel kısıtlılığı belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın bir dinsel durum ve bu durumdaki kişi anlamındadır; genel uzak durma anlamı tanıma taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Cinsel ilişki sonrasında arınma yapılıncaya kadar kişinin namazdan ve mescitten uzak durduğu dinsel durumdur. Bu durumda bulunan kadın, erkek veya topluluk da aynı adlandırmayla nitelenebilir.

facets.statement: Cinsel ilişki sonrasında arınma gerektiren ve kişiyi namazdan ve mescitten uzak tutan durumu belirtir.
Bu durumda bulunan kadın, erkek veya birden çok kişiyi niteleyebilir.
Adlandırma, kişinin arınana kadar namazdan ve mescitten uzak durmasıyla açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak tanım, cinsel ilişki sonrasında başlayan ve arınmaya kadar kişiyi namazdan ve mescitten uzak tutan durumdur. Durumun adı, bu uzak durmayla ilişkilendirilir.

error_profile.preserves: Cinsel ilişki sonrası oluşmayı, dinsel kısıtı ve arınma gereğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cinsel ilişki sonrası geçici dinsel kısıt altında bulunan kişinin nitelenmesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin arınma gerektiren geçici durumunu bağlam içinde korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal ifadesi hayvanı veya tutsağı kişinin yanında götürmesini ve yanda götürülen varlığı destekler. Yarışta yedek at bulundurma yasağı yalnız ayrı bir sözcük biriminde tanıklanmıştır; bu nedenle dal tanımına kurucu anlam olarak alınmamış, yalnız o birimin karşılığında korunmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir varlığı kişinin yanında bağlı veya yönlendirilmiş biçimde götürmektir; genel eşlikçilik değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın götürme çekirdeği ile hayvan, tutsak ve yarış bağlamındaki belirli birimler ayrı tutulur; yarış yasağı bütüne genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir hayvanı veya tutsağı kişinin kendi yanında, bağlı ya da yönlendirilmiş biçimde götürmesidir. Bu biçimde yanda götürülen hayvan veya bağlı tutsak da aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Bir hayvanı veya tutsağı kişinin kendi yanında yönlendirerek götürmesini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Anlam çekirdeği, bir hayvanı ya da tutsağı kişinin yanında yönlendirerek götürmesidir. Eylem, yanda çekilen hayvanı ve hayvana bağlı tutsağı adlandıran sonuç biçimlerine de uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal ifadesi belirli bir yönden esen, kuzey yeline karşıt ve çoğu kez sıcak sayılan yeli açıkça tanımlar. Bu yelin esmesi, insanların ona girmesi veya bir bulutu sürüklemesi ayrı sözcük birimlerinde tanıklanır; bunlar dalın yönsel yel çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Belirli yelin yalın adı ile esme, ona tutulma ve bulut sürükleme yapıları ayrıdır; yapıların olay anlamı yalın ada yüklenmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal ifadesi insanın böğür ağrısını veya akciğer zarı hastalığını ve devenin aşırı susuzluk sonucu akciğerinin böğrüne yapışmasını destekler. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli iyi ve kötü adlarıyla kurulan yapıda çokluk anlamını doğrular. İyilik için verilen kişinin yanında bulunma açıklaması olası bir anlamlandırmadır; çekirdek, söz konusu iyi veya kötünün çok miktarda olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Belirli söz öbeğinde iyilik veya kötülüğün çok miktarda olmasını belirtir.
